welcome_title: 🎯 JobSniper ET — AI Job Matcher & Career Coach
welcome_body: Welcome, {name}! I continuously monitor 50+ Ethiopian job channels 24/7 (HaHuJobs, Ethiojobs, Freelance Ethiopia, NGO vacancies, and more) to find high-match opportunities tailored to your profile. ✨ What I do for you: • Real-time AI Match Alerts: Instant alerts when opportunities hit your 80%+ threshold. • Instant Cover Letters: Tailored 3-paragraph drafts mapping your exact skills to the role. • AI Mock Interview Coach: 5-question STAR simulation via text or voice notes with instant feedback.
onboarding_prompt: 📄 Set Up Your Career Profile To start receiving sniper alerts, please choose how you want to build your profile:
upload_cv_instructions: 📤 Upload Your Resume / CV Please send your CV as a file attachment (PDF or DOCX format, up to 10MB). 🔒 Your CV is encrypted with bank-grade AES-256-GCM. We never share your data.
cv_processing: ⏳ Analyzing your CV with Gemini AI... • Extracting professional experience • Identifying core skills & competencies • Generating vector embedding profile Please wait a few seconds...
cv_error: ⚠️ Could not read document Please ensure you upload a valid PDF or Word (.docx) document containing readable text.
wizard_step1: 🎓 Step 1 of 4: Education & Field of Study What is your highest degree and field of study? Example: B.Sc. in Computer Science or BA in Management
wizard_step2: 💼 Step 2 of 4: Professional Experience How many years of experience do you have, and what is your primary job title? Example: 2 years as Junior Frontend Developer or Fresh Graduate / Entry Level
wizard_step3: 🛠️ Step 3 of 4: Core Skills What are your strongest technical or professional skills? (Separate with commas) Example: Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Git, Team Leadership
wizard_step4: 📍 Step 4 of 4: Preferences & Location What work arrangement and location do you prefer? Example: Full-time in Addis Ababa, or Remote Tech Roles
wizard_completed: 🎉 Profile Created via Guided Builder! We've indexed your preferences. You are now ready to receive personalized sniper match alerts!
cover_letter_generating: ✍️ Crafting your tailored cover letter... Aligning your qualifications with this specific job description.
cover_letter_ready: 📄 Tailored Cover Letter Draft {letter} 💡 Tap the text above to copy it instantly. Customize bracketed details before sending!
interview_intro: 🎙️ AI Mock Interview Coach (STAR Method) Target Role: {title} at {company} We'll conduct a realistic 5-question simulation: 1️⃣ Professional Pitch & Background 2️⃣ Technical / Competency Deep Dive 3️⃣ Behavioral Challenge (STAR Method) 4️⃣ Problem-Solving Under Pressure 5️⃣ Cultural Fit & Closing Impact How would you like to answer?
interview_started: 🚀 Mock Interview Started! Respond in English using {mode_text}. Take a breath and answer professionally.
interview_voice_hint: 👉 Record and send a voice note (under 2 minutes).
interview_completed: 🏁 Mock Interview Simulation Complete! 📊 Performance Assessment Report: 🎯 Overall Readiness Score: {score}/10.0 • Technical Substance: {tech_score}/10 • STAR Structure: {star_score}/10 • Clarity & Articulation: {comm_score}/10 📋 Key Feedback: {feedback} ⭐ Top Recommendation: {recommendation}
